planet.firstcrusade.imperial_capital.des: A massive Imperial capital covered by enormous cities, military districts, cathedrals, manufactorums and command centres. It serves as one of the main strategic hubs for Imperial forces. Recruit soldiers, trade resources, receive military missions and access advanced technology. The central regions are secure; the outer wastes are not.
planet.firstcrusade.imperial_capital.res: Military supplies, recruitment, advanced technology, trade.
planet.firstcrusade.cadia.description: A heavily fortified world positioned near an unstable region of space. Its cities, fortresses and defensive lines have been built for permanent warfare. Travelling to Cadia gives access to large military conflicts, defensive missions, Imperial recruitment and valuable salvage.
planet.firstcrusade.cadia.resources: Military supplies, weapons, armour and strategic materials.
planet.firstcrusade.armageddon.descripti: An industrial world consumed by constant warfare. Vast hive-factories pour smoke into a sky that has not been clear in centuries, and the greenskin war never truly ends. Vehicle production, industrial salvage and urban battles on a scale nothing else matches.
planet.firstcrusade.forge_world.descript: A world owned by the Adeptus Mechanicus, where the horizon is manufactorum and the air tastes of oil. Weapon production, advanced technology and industrial defence missions. Nothing grows here that was not built.
planet.firstcrusade.hive_world.descripti: Towering hive cities holding billions, stacked over an underhive nobody governs. Gangs, corruption, factories and internal conflict. Urban missions and a population large enough that nobody counts the losses.
planet.firstcrusade.agri_world.descripti: Endless cultivated continents feeding a dozen war zones. Farms, fields, forests and small towns, defended by militia rather than by armies. Raids on the harvest are the war here.
planet.firstcrusade.ork_world.descriptio: Hostile territory from orbit down. Ork camps, scrap fortresses, hordes and the Warbosses that drive them. Conquest events, high risk and rewards to match. Nothing on this world wants a negotiation.
planet.firstcrusade.necron_tomb_world.de: Ancient ruins over structures that go down further than any survey has mapped. The technology here is not understood, and the things sleeping under it are counting. Rare resources, dangerous expeditions and awakening events.
planet.firstcrusade.necron_tomb_world.re: Living metal, unknown technology, rare artefacts.
planet.firstcrusade.catachan.description: A death world of jungle and swamp where the flora is as hostile as anything with teeth. The Imperium holds only what it can defend daily. Everything here is either poisonous, armoured, or both.
planet.firstcrusade.valhalla.description: An ice world whose temperature never rises above freezing. Imperial garrisons hold the habitable belts; everything else is tundra over the bones of older wars.
